display.purpose: Home desktop heading; page-specific variants remain composition-owned.

title.purpose: Offer titles; Projects menu rows use Manrope 700 24px/30px, compact panel rows 700 20px/28px.

label.purpose: Uppercase primary navigation, buttons and eyebrows; numbered menu indexes use Silkscreen 12px/16px.

lettering.purpose: Expressive case/service numerals; hero/footer have their own sizes.

motion.name: action-lift
motion.purpose: Pointer hover feedback; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: project-lift
motion.purpose: Project cover hover and keyboard focus; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable motion transitions/GSAP effects and retain static splat fallback.

motion.name: navigation-transition
motion.purpose: Desktop active pill, authored arrow reveal and megamenu opacity; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: portrait-travel-easing
motion.purpose: Reversible scroll progress controlling shared-stage position, width, height and model baseline. Destination dimensions are capped by origin and slot bounds, then centered; never grow to fill the larger bio slot.

motion.name: portrait-bio-yaw
motion.purpose: Final three-quarter pose faces bio copy; manual offset fades with travel and is unavailable at arrival.

motion.name: portrait-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Two still placements with no interpolated movement; static fallback replaces 3D loading.

motion.name: portrait-stage-geometry
motion.value: targetWidth = min(origin.width, slot.width); targetHeight = min(origin.height, slot.height)
motion.purpose: Published-size reference: desktop origin 640px × 480px; mobile origin min(350px, viewport width minus 40px) × 325px. Center within the destination. Reviewed destinations: 640px × 480px desktop, 498px × 480px at 1135px, 339px × 325px mobile. Portrait z-index 1 stays below hero heading, body, actions, lettering and relatively positioned About copy at z-index 2.

narrative.overview:
This is an expressive portfolio in which project imagery, Pedro's portrait and authored illustrations carry the identity. Rounded organic surfaces and warm editorial type are punctuated by precise pixel lettering, small technical labels and orange SVG marks. The phrase above describes the implemented world; it is not a new public tagline.

The approved Current Figma frames govern composition. Pixel orange eyebrows, project cards, illustrated offer cards and oversized footer lettering are intentional parts of that world. White page surfaces, pale green sections and cream secondary surfaces leave room for the work. Preserve this identity when extending it; do not replace it with a generic dashboard or a different visual metaphor.
keyCharacteristics: Work imagery and a preserved Gaussian splat portrait lead the experience.
White page surfaces alternate with cream and pale green support surfaces.
Manrope and Hanken Grotesk provide readable hierarchy around pixel accents.
Pill controls, rounded media and orange pixel SVGs recur across pages.
Desktop compositions adapt deliberately to one-column mobile reading.

rules.name: The Brand and Contrast Rule
rules.body: Preserve exact brand orange. Use the existing readable ink and action shades when text contrast requires them; do not collapse the separate roles into one orange.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: The page canvas uses surface in both themes. Cream background tokens remain for secondary surfaces and controls.

rules.name: The Five Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep titles in Manrope, prose in Hanken, interface labels in Silkscreen, technical details in Geist Mono and expressive lettering in Pixelify.

rules.name: The Selective Depth Rule
rules.body: Use shadows for floating controls, inset media and established feature surfaces. Use borders and tone for ordinary grouping.

dos: **Do** use the approved Current desktop/mobile Figma frames as visual authority.
**Do** preserve pixel orange eyebrows, image-led project cards and the original splat portrait.
**Do** keep the single portrait stage reversible between hero and bio, with a fixed copy-facing destination pose.
**Do** cap the desktop portrait at 640px × 480px, fit narrower destination columns, and keep all hero/About copy above the travelling model.
**Do** keep closed desktop menus inert and make the visible Light label activate its theme radio.
**Do** separate exact brand orange from readable ink and action shades.
**Do** use white page surfaces and reserve cream for secondary surfaces and controls.
**Do** keep all five type families in their established roles and self-host their files.
**Do** provide visible keyboard focus, accessible native controls and reduced-motion fallbacks.
**Do** adapt layouts at the established widths and keep mobile side gutters at 20px.
donts: **Don't** substitute Unicode arrows or checks for exported SVG icons.
**Don't** turn unconfirmed metrics, quotes, prices or availability into verified product claims.
**Don't** fill missing case narratives or gallery assets with invented content.
**Don't** canonize legacy CSS aliases, duplicated cascade rules or hidden old sections as new design patterns.
**Don't** apply decorative pixel fonts to long body copy or replace established font roles.
**Don't** remove the static portrait fallback or force motion when reduced motion is requested.
**Don't** restore a separate Home bio photograph or allow manual rotation to override the final portrait pose.
**Don't** grow the portrait to fill the larger bio slot or let it obscure text during travel.
**Don't** present unavailable links, downloads or an unconfigured form as working destinations.
